# skills.agentprivacy.ai

> The skills door of the agentprivacy universe: packet catalogue, loadouts, one SKILL.md per packet. A skill supplies a method. Updated 12 September 2026.

## Start

- The entry (one command, five starting doors): https://agentprivacy.org/skill.md · https://agentprivacy.org/begin/#one-command

- Loadouts: https://skills.agentprivacy.ai/#loadouts
